text: Preporuka za doktoricu Tamaru. Nisem mogla naći bolju doktoricu za svoju Aninu.

Dugogodisnja sam pacijentica doktorice Tamare. Nosila sam fiksni aparat i prezadovoljna sam sa svojim novim osmjehom! Imala sam dosta kompliciranu situaciju pa su mi preporučili doktoricu. Odusevljena sam kako mi je uspjela raširiti osmijeh. Hvala dr Tamari :)

Moja Elena je već godinama dolazi kod doktorice. Oduševljeni smo pristupom i rezultatom . Kao roditelju mi je jako bitno da osjećam da osoba koja radi sa djecom pokazuje razumjevanje  da voli djecu! Izuzetan profesionalizam, sve pohvale!

Dopo 3.200 euro spese e 18 mesi di esperimenti, modifiche, foto, per le quali non ci ha mai richiesto permessi, finalmente ne siamo usciti.  Esperienza da dimenticare alla svelta, persona con scarsa empatia con la nostra ragazzina di 11 anni, al punto di instillarle paure ingiustificate di possibili interventi chirurgici in futuro.
A fronte delle sue dichiarazioni allarmistiche la nostra ragazzina si è messa a piangere ed ha avuto anche l'ardire di affermare che lei si comportasse come un attrice.
Non sopporta domande da parte nostra, non sopporta critica, e non cerca di tranquillizzare ne la piccola paziente, ne i genitori nonostante le nostre preoccupazioni e nonostante l'importo elevato richiesto per le sue prestazioni.
Ha saltato ben due volte gli appuntamenti fissati, nonostante distanti ben 70 km dal suo studio, e spostato gli stessi in base alle sue esigenze non tenendo conto che la ragazza andava a scuola.
Ha cambiato metodologia durante il corso dell'applicazione dell'apparecchio dentale, senza spiegarci le motivazioni e si pone  su un piedistallo dall'alto della sua autovantata professionalità.
Ci era stata consigliata da una dentista di Podgorica, ma ci siamo pentiti di esserci rivolti a lei per le cure che tra l'altro riteniamo inadeguate e superflue per una ragazzina di 11 anni.
Naturalmente non vogliamo sostituirci alla sua professione, ma da genitori non siamo affatto soddisfatti ne dai risultati finali, ne dall'approccio professionale avuto con nostra figlia, e ci siamo trovati in una situazione assai poco confortevole durante tutto il trattamento.
I had good experience there, doctor & nurse were very polite and understanding...
Dr. Zoran and his team make the definition of the most atrentive and profesional Dental care one can expect. As a Physician and his patient, I 100% recommend him

Great experience. Everyone at the dental studio was very professional, kind and welcoming. The clinic felt very cozy, is super clean and modern, I felt comfortable the whole time. Absolutely no pain (even when I requested not to have anesthesia) and great results. I’ll be coming back for sure!
Very good professional
Best doctor really professional and gentleman im crew member ship and when I com kotor directly im visit him

I had a great experience at this dental clinic! The clinic is very clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The dentist is very professional, skilled, and attentive. The assistant is also very friendly, helpful, and communicates well, making the whole experience pleasant and stress-free. I truly appreciate their excellent service and the care they provide. Highly recommended!
My composite bonding chipped whilst on holiday in Montenegro and this amazing clinic has me fixed at an amazing standard in less than 4 hours. Thank you!

I broke a tooth when on holiday and Zoran was recommended to me he was so good that I asked him to also carry out my teeth cleaning and this was exceptionally good I really like the way Zoran explains the issues with my teeth 👌

While on holiday in Kotor I had severe toothache,and my Hotel was able to make an urgent appointment. I received a full consultation, examination, xrays and advice, and the treatment was carried out carefully and successfully. The Dentist made several follow up calls afterwards to make sure I was healing properly, important because we were travelling on from Kotor for the rest of our holiday. Whilst it was unfortunate to have dental pain on holiday, it was very fortunate to have this Dentist to treat me! It was especially helpful that it could all be discussed in the English language as we were obviously a long way from home. Thanks for the service.

Во время путешествия столкнулась с острой болью в зубе мудрости
Изучала разные клиники, и выбрала данную по отзывам. Очень привлекло, что врач англоговорящий и мог предоставить документы для страховки. Зуб вылечили, врач подробно все объяснил, сделал рентген снимок. Весь процесс прошел очень хорошо и профессионально. Также приятно что врач был всегда на связи и отвечал на все мои вопросы. Рекомендую всем местным и путешественникам обращаться за помощью в данную клинику.

Went here because I thought a filling needs to be replaced. Ended up in just a check up. Doctor did 2 x-rays and recommended to do nothing. Nice to see that he is interested in the well being of the patient and doesn't do things that are unnecessary. Also thanks for the very quick appointment within 24 h. Highly recommend also when you are traveling through.
Very good dental clinic, the people very kind and professional , they speak proper English .

The man is a thief. He stole a golden crown claiming he threw it away because he thought it was brass. He charged 265 euros for a simple root extraction without complications. When asked for the invoice he delayed for 3 days and then sent one for an incorrect amount with no details about the procedure performed.
Simply FAST, EFFECTIVE & most importantly PAINLESS 🫡

Этот врач полностью не компетентный. Я пришла к нему с опухолью на десне и болью в зубе . Сначала сделала рентген , после пришла уже на прием . Врач посмотрел на зуб и сказал только удаление . Для меня это была трагедия , так как у меня и так нету 3 зубов , и потерять четвертый зуб это для меня слишком плохо .
Я не поверила ему и поехала в другую клинику , где мне за 2 приема вылечили зуб и запломбировали.
Не верьте этому доктору , если он говорит удалять зуб , скорее всего он просто не хочет этим заниматься и лечить . Лучше перепроверьте в другой клинике.
Я очень рада , что не послушала и пошла в другую клинику .

Otišao sam po preporuci prijatelja. 185 e za snimak zuba i deo plombe. Živim u Dubai-u već 12 godina i nikad ne platih toliko. Ni upola… u Dubaiu kod VRHUNSKIH lekara. Sramno i bezobrazno. Ali, svaka roba ima svog kupca. I ovce i jesu za šišanje.
